requirements.title: Integrate Curator into the root project
Represent Curator functionality in the ontology
Make relationships and current sources discoverable
Deliver complete neutral capability through the Template
Complete both integrations during new-project creation
Complete both integrations during first existing-project preparation
Support selected adoption by previously initialized projects
Preserve project data and recover exact setup operations
Preserve session triggers and canonical owner authority
Resolve the reported pending owner maintenance
Reconcile the staged Task response through its owner
Verify the selected on-demand ontology workbench
Preserve healthy memory and ontology behavior
Report integration success with inspectable evidence
